newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin, Major speak on telephone.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin, Major speak on telephone.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin spoke to British Prime Minister John Major by telephone on Monday, the Russian leader's first day back in the Kremlin after his heart bypass operation seven weeks ago.
A presidential spokesman said further details would be released later.

Among other world leaders, Yeltsin has spoken with U.S. President Bill Clinton, German Chancellor Helmut Kohl and French President Jacques Chirac since undergoing heart surgery on November 5. He plans to meet all three of them next year.
